name: Dossier v1 AI Job Search and Resume Tailor
description: Track job applications and generate tailored resumes and cover letters.

upstream.version: 1.10.0 (tag v1.10.0, commit a1ab9216b8723c25cf4ed60596cd886e753086da; image ghcr.io/aientech/dossier:v1.10.0, index digest sha256:2a4dd7b790637fbf9135b462c584ccfdf056f28836a6dd17fd8a660cffd2d677, created 2026-10-29)

DOSSIER_LOGIN_PASSWORD.description: Your sign-in password, generated at deploy (min. 12 chars). Hashed with argon2id at boot; Dossier never sees it in plain text. Change and redeploy to rotate.

DOSSIER_PASSWORD.description: Optional. An argon2id hash from Dossier's hash-password tool. When set it is used instead of DOSSIER_LOGIN_PASSWORD, so you can delete the plain password.

DOSSIER_SECRET.description: Signs sessions, encrypts API keys saved in Settings and salts the login hash. Keep it: changing it signs you out and makes saved keys unreadable.

DATABASE_URL.description: Postgres on the private network. Migrations run on every boot.

PORT.description: Port the Next.js server listens on. The public domain and the healthcheck use it.

HOSTNAME.description: Bind address. :: listens on IPv4 and IPv6 (Node is dual-stack).

DOSSIER_PUBLIC_URL.description: Public HTTPS address, used for Google sign-in and the Claude connector. Change to https://{your-domain} when you add a custom domain.

DOSSIER_DATA_DIR.description: Nightly backups, pre-import backups and PDF zips. Must stay on the /data volume.

DOSSIER_BACKUP_RETENTION_DAYS.description: Days of nightly backups kept on the volume.

TZ.description: Time zone for nightly backups (03:00) and the job agent, e.g. Europe/Berlin.

DOSSIER_AI_PROVIDER.description: Optional default AI provider: openai, anthropic, mistral, local or lmstudio. Empty: choose in Settings > AI provider (saved choices win).

DOSSIER_AI_KEY.description: Optional API key for DOSSIER_AI_PROVIDER. Better: enter it in Settings, where it is stored encrypted. The app runs without one.

DOSSIER_AI_MODEL.description: Optional default model. Empty: Dossier's default for Anthropic and Mistral; OpenAI-compatible and local providers need one here or in Settings.

DOSSIER_AI_URL.description: Optional base URL for an OpenAI-compatible server or Ollama, e.g. http://ollama.railway.internal:11434.

DOSSIER_JOBS_SOURCE.description: Optional default job source: adzuna, jsearch, freehire or off. Empty: Find jobs stays off until you pick one in Settings.

DOSSIER_JOBS_ARBEITSAGENTUR.description: off removes the unofficial Bundesagentur für Arbeit source, whose terms forbid automated access. on offers it behind an in-app warning.

DOSSIER_TELEMETRY.description: Optional usage ping answer: on or off. Empty: Dossier asks once after sign-in and sends nothing before a yes.

DOSSIER_DB_WAIT_SECONDS.description: How long boot waits for Postgres before giving up (Railway then restarts the service).

DOSSIER_VERSION.description: Tag of ghcr.io/aientech/dossier, passed to the build. Change and redeploy to upgrade; read the upgrade notes and back up first.

PGDATA.description: Location where the database will be initialized.

PGDATABASE.description: Required variable for the data panel.

POSTGRES_DB.description: Default database created when image is started.

DATABASE_URL.description: URL to connect to Postgres database.

POSTGRES_USER.description: User to connect to Postgres DB.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Allow Postgres to cleanly shut down.
